subject: URGENT: EU RTT & p95/p99 jump — HelioHealth hosted API
messages:
From: Tom Keller <tom.keller@heliohealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@heliohealth.com
Date: Fri, 3 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: High p95/p99 since 08:30 UTC — HelioHealth hosted API impact

Laura and Redwood team,

We're seeing a sharp regression in response times for your hosted API since ~08:30 UTC (EU region). Key points: 
- p50: ~180ms -> 220ms (small)
- p95: ~210ms -> ~1.2s (major)
- p99: ~420ms -> ~2.3s
- 5xx error rate spiked from ~0.01% to 0.8% during the window
- Overall throughput dropped ~18% for our EU traffic

This started right after a brief maintenance window we observed on your side — our traffic to api.redwood.ai/eu looks like it's being routed to the US cluster intermittently (we captured traces). This is breaking real-time features for our EU users.

I've attached a trace log and a couple of request IDs (rid: 5f7a-... at 08:34:12 UTC, rid: 6b1c-... at 08:39:05 UTC). Can you confirm whether any routing or peering changes were applied at your edge around 07:40-08:40 UTC UTC? We need an ETA for mitigation — this is high priority for us.

- Tom
Tom Keller
Head of Ops, HelioHealth

Attachments: rtt-diff-20290503.log (traces)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Keller <tom.keller@heliohealth.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 May 2029 09:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High p95/p99 since 08:30 UTC — HelioHealth hosted API impact

Tom — thanks for the rapid flag. I'm really sorry for the disruption. We're treating this as SEV-1 for HelioHealth and I've looped in on-call (Vivek), our edge/network lead (Rafael) and your account exec (Vanessa).

Immediate asks from our side so we can act fast:
- Can you drop one or two example request IDs back into this thread (we have the ones you sent — thanks) and the timestamps you noted.
- If you have any internal trace/span IDs we can match, send them to Vivek (cc'd).

Vivek/Rafael — initial context: HelioHealth is seeing EU-origin traffic being egressed to our us-east serving pool intermittently starting around 08:30 UTC. Customer traces attached. Please investigate peering/route changes, BGP anomalies, and any recent config pushes to edge-router-proxy in eu-prod. If we need to steer traffic back immediately, please propose the rollback steps and an ETA.

I'll keep Tom updated every 15 minutes until resolved.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tom Keller <tom.keller@heliohealth.com>
Cc: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 May 2029 09:36:45 -07:00
Subject: Re: High p95/p99 since 08:30 UTC — HelioHealth hosted API impact

Laura / Tom — I'm on it. Quick read of our edge telemetry shows a BGP path preference flip for a subset of eu-prod prefixes beginning ~07:44 UTC. That flip increases avg RTT by ~600-800ms for flows that now traverse to us-east before landing on eu serving nodes (makes sense with the RTT delta you're seeing).

What I've run so far: 
- traceroute samples from eu-ingress -> showed hop to us-east-router-2 for several flows
- edge logs: NOVALUE change event at 07:45:22 UTC tied to config deployment job #deploy-9843
- correlation: spike in route preference metrics at 07:44:xx UTC

Proposed immediate mitigation (requires sign-off):
1) Revert route-map 'prefer-us-east' applied during deploy-9843 (edge-router-proxy configs)
2) Reprogram traffic steering for eu-prod to prefer eu-edge-peers (hot rollback)
3) Monitor p95/p99; expect improvement within 6–12 minutes if route converges cleanly

If you want me to run the rollback now, I will proceed and post the exact commands and pre/post checks.

— Vivek (oncall)
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tom Keller <tom.keller@heliohealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 May 2029 09:42:10 -07:00
Subject: Re: High p95/p99 since 08:30 UTC — HelioHealth hosted API impact

Thanks, Vivek. Confirmed — I can see the config diff from deploy-9843 that unintentionally set 'edge.route.prefer_us' true for eu-prod. That flag was meant for an internal test and should not have been promoted. 

Rollback plan (I'm executing now):
- sudo edge-configctl rollback deploy-9843 --target eu-prod
- verify route-map: show route-map eu-prod | grep prefer_us (should be absent)
- reload edge-router-proxy (graceful) on eu-edge-01, eu-edge-02
- validate via traceroute samples and our synthetic p95 probes

I'll post pre/post metrics. ETA for stabilization: 7–10 minutes after the config is reverted. See attached route-table-diff.png for the before/after snippet.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Network Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: route-table-diff.png
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 3 May 2029 10:05:30 -07:00
Subject: Re: High p95/p99 since 08:30 UTC — HelioHealth hosted API impact

Tom — on behalf of Redwood, I'm really sorry for the outage and the impact to HelioHealth users. Rafael and Vivek are rolling the rollback now; Laura is leading comms and I will make sure we follow up with a formal RCA.

Immediate next steps for you:
- Rafael's rollback will likely normalize p95/p99 within ~10 minutes; I will confirm when we see p95 back to baseline.
- Post-mitigation: we'll offer a credit for the affected hour(s) and include a detailed impact summary in the RCA doc. I'm attaching the impact summary we will send to your Ops & Finance teams for initial review.

Can we hop on a 20-minute bridge at 10:30 UTC to align on postmortem timeline and credits? If that's OK I will send a calendar invite.

Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: HelioHealth_impact_summary.docx
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, rafael.mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 May 2029 18:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec summary: HelioHealth EU latency regression (routing misconfig) — credit request

Aditya / Marissa — quick exec note summarizing today's HelioHealth escalation (for your awareness / approval):

- Incident: EU-origin traffic intermittently routed to US serving pool due to a misapplied edge config during deploy-9843 (flag: prefer_us).
- Impact window: ~07:44 UTC -> 08:12 UTC (approx 28 minutes)
- Customer impact: p95 rose to ~1.2s (baseline ~210ms), p99 to ~2.3s, 5xx increase ~0.8% during peak. Throughput for the account down ~18% for EU flows.
- Action taken: Rafael rolled back deploy-9843; Vivek monitored convergence. p95/p99 returned to baseline within ~9 minutes of rollback.
- Customer status: HelioHealth accepted our initial apology and asked for a 10:30 UTC bridge; Vanessa proposed credits and an RCA.

Recommendation for leadership approval: offer a goodwill credit of $22,500 to HelioHealth (one-off, not contract amendment) and expedite a <48h RCA with network change controls remediation + a postmortem with timeline. Vanessa to own customer comms; Rafael will publish technical RCA.

Please confirm approval or advise an alternate amount/approach. I'll hold public-facing comms until we have sign-off.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
